# TutorChase

> Elite online tutoring platform and premium revision resources for international and UK qualifications including GCSE, IGCSE, A-Level, IB, and AP exams.

TutorChase connects students with professional, qualified tutors and provides comprehensive revision materials including practice questions, study notes, and past papers across multiple exam boards (Edexcel, AQA, CIE, OCR). The platform specializes in exam preparation for GCSE, IGCSE, A-Level, IB, AP, and university admissions including Oxbridge and US college applications.

## Key Topics

- GCSE
- IGCSE
- A-Level
- IB (International Baccalaureate)
- AP (Advanced Placement)
- Exam preparation
- Practice questions
- Past papers
- Study notes
- Online tutors
- Qualified teachers
- Oxbridge admissions
- US college admissions
- Exam boards (Edexcel, AQA, CIE, OCR)
- Subject specialists

## Core Platform

- [TutorChase Homepage](https://www.tutorchase.com): TutorChase homepage: elite online tutoring and revision resources for IB, A-Level, AP, IGCSE, GCSE.
- [Online Revision Platform](https://www.tutorchase.com/resources): Main revision platform with GCSE, IGCSE, A-Level, IB practice questions, notes, past papers.
- [Professional Tutors Directory](https://www.tutorchase.com/tutors): Directory of professional qualified tutors for GCSE, IGCSE, A-Level, IB, AP, university admissions.

## UK Qualification Programs

- [GCSE Revision Resources](https://www.tutorchase.com/resources/gcse): GCSE revision resources: practice questions, notes, past papers for AQA, Edexcel, OCR.
- [Online GCSE Tutors](https://www.tutorchase.com/gcse): Professional GCSE tutors for all subjects from qualified Oxbridge-educated teachers.
- [IGCSE Revision Resources](https://www.tutorchase.com/resources/igcse): IGCSE revision resources: practice questions, notes, past papers for CIE, Edexcel.
- [Online IGCSE Tutors](https://www.tutorchase.com/igcse): Professional IGCSE tutors for all subjects from qualified examiners and teachers.
- [A-Level Revision Resources](https://www.tutorchase.com/resources/a-level): A-Level revision resources: practice questions, notes, past papers for AQA, CIE, Edexcel.
- [Online A-Level Tutors](https://www.tutorchase.com/a-level): Professional A-Level tutors for all subjects from qualified Oxbridge-educated teachers.

## International Qualification Programs

- [IB Revision Resources](https://www.tutorchase.com/resources/ib): IB-specific revision resources: practice questions, study notes, mock papers by IB examiners.
- [Online IB Tutors](https://www.tutorchase.com/ib): Professional IB tutors for IBDP and MYP from qualified examiners and specialists.
- [AP Revision Resources](https://www.tutorchase.com/resources/ap): AP exam prep resources: practice questions, notes, past papers for College Board exams.
- [Online AP Tutors](https://www.tutorchase.com/ap): Professional AP tutors for all subjects helping students achieve top exam scores.

## University & College Admissions

- [Oxbridge Tutors](https://www.tutorchase.com/oxbridge): Oxford and Cambridge application tutoring: admissions tests, interviews, personal statements.
- [US College Application Support](https://www.tutorchase.com/us-college-admissions): US college admissions support: SAT, ACT, essays, interviews for Ivy League and top schools.
